name: AvatarDialog
description:
Change a person's photo: drop, browse for or paste an image, position it in the round crop
(drag, pinch, wheel or keys; the slider zooms) and save. The dialog checks the file against
`requirements` before it can be cropped and hands the cropped square to `onSave`; the
application uploads it. Outside presses do not close it, so a crop is never lost by a stray
click; Cancel and Esc abort a save that is still running.
signature: ({ trigger, open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, name, src, file, requirements, output, onSave, onRemove, onReject, title, }: AvatarDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: file
props.description: A file to start from when the dialog opens, such as one dropped on the page.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's (or account's) name: the subtitle, and the initials when there is no photo.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state when the trigger opens it, Cancel, Esc or the close button dismisses it, or it closes after a save or removal. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called for each file refused by the requirements, with the reason shown in the dialog.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove the current photo; runs like `onSave`. Without it, or without `src`, there is no Remove button.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Save the photo: upload `change.blob` (or `change.original` with `change.crop`). The dialog
shows pending until the promise settles, then ✓ and closes. If it rejects, the dialog stays
open with the error's message (write it for the person) or a generic one.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: output
props.description: The cropped image: size in pixels (default 512), media type (default WebP) and quality.

props.name: requirements
props.description: What a photo must satisfy: types, bytes, minimum dimensions and the application's own check.

props.name: src
props.description: The current photo, shown until a new one is chosen.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it. Omit when controlling `open`.
